_about: Sequence databases and protein language models served from DATA_URL. They are large, so they are fetched only when named (IMP.bff.fetch_sequence_data, imp_bff_fetch_data --sequences), never by fetch_data()'s all-fetch or by get_data_path(). The download resumes after an interruption and is checked against sha256.

uniref_consurf.description: UniRef50 representatives (38.84 M) over their UniRef90 members (121.5 M), clustered, with the ESM-2 embedding prefilter (model + index) inside: the one file a ConSurf run needs (ConsurfOptions.database).
uniref_consurf.source: UniProt UniRef50 and UniRef90, downloaded September 2026 (CC BY 4.0)

uniprot_sprot.description: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (575,748 reviewed sequences) as a sequence database: a small database for tests, examples and quick searches.

esm2_35m.description: ESM-2 t12 35M with the contrastive projection head of the embedding prefilter (ProteinLanguageModel). Already inside uniref_consurf.

esm2_650m_contacts.description: ESM-2 t33 650M with its contact head (ProteinLanguageModel.get_contacts, probe_pair_contacts).
